chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 447 – Ghost Sound, Yakshas, and Han Li’s Cold Patience
chapter_meta_description: Han Li watches as a demon cultivator is crushed by a shadow ghost and its yaksha minions. Fairy Zi Ling recovers from a soul-reaving attack. A hidden ghost strikes from the mist—Mortal Stream patience meets brutal xianxia combat.
og_description: A shadow ghost with a green pearl overwhelms a demon cultivator while Yakshas pin down the Crying Soul Beast. Han Li waits, watches, then strikes—only to find more enemies in the mist.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 447 – Waiting for the right moment
twitter_description: Han Li doesn’t rush to save his arrogant ally—he reads the battlefield first. Ghost yakshas, soul-reaving sounds, and a hidden killer in the mist.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade innate ghost art that forces victims to lose control of their bodies and dance uncontrollably; can be resisted by guarding the heart-mind.
A rare zombie variant with a physical body, capable of moving in daylight; recognized by green fur, pointed heads, and bone forks that shoot ghost-fire.
A rare spirit beast whose nose emits a soul-sucking yellow light that devours ghost-fire and spirit energy; young specimens have only this one ability.
A yin-aligned death-attribute energy that can smother demonic flame; often produced by ghostly artifacts like the green pearl.
Animate undead mist found in the Ghost Grievance Ground, churned by combat and acting as a medium for ghostly auras.
A cultivator’s spiritual center; guarding it is the standard defense against psychic and ghostly attacks in xianxia.
The black-robed man’s life-bound flying treasure, a crimson hammer that sprays blue demonic flame; overwhelmed by higher-grade Xuan Yin energy.
